# `collab/CollabTransformSync.js`

> **Source:** `engine/collab/CollabTransformSync.js`

CollabTransformSync.js Broadcasts entity transform updates during play mode so grabbed/moved objects are visible on all peer screens in real time. Authority model: - The peer who presses Play becomes the physics authority. - Authority broadcasts ALL entity transforms at ~10Hz. - Non-authority peers receive and apply transforms, skipping local physics. - Grabbed entity transforms are always sent at ~15Hz by anyone.

## Functions

### `createTransformSync()`

Create a transform sync state object.

### `trackLocalGrab(syncState, entityId)`

Mark an entity as being actively grabbed/dragged by the local user.

### `untrackLocalGrab(syncState, entityId)`

Unmark an entity when released.

### `buildPlayTransformOp(syncState, ecsWorld, getEntityComponent)`

Build a play_transforms op for grabbed entities only. Returns null if nothing to broadcast or if throttled.

### `buildFullPlayTransformOp(syncState, ecsWorld, getEntityComponent, sceneEntities, entityAuthority, spatialAuthoritySet)`

Build a play_transforms op for ALL scene entities. Only called by the physics authority at ~10Hz.

**Parameters:**

- `syncState` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `ecsWorld` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `getEntityComponent` *(Function)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `sceneEntities` *(Map)* — editor.scene.entities map
- `[entityAuthority]` *(Object)* — CollabEntityAuthority state for per-entity ownership
- `[spatialAuthoritySet]` *(Set)* — If provided, only broadcast entities in this set (spatial zone filter)

**Returns:** |null}

### `buildPbdStateOp(syncState, physicsSimulations, spatialAuthoritySet)`

Build a play_pbd_state op that snapshots PBD particle positions. Any peer running physics simulations broadcasts at ~30Hz for real-time rope sync. Only includes sims with >0 particles. Full float precision for smooth visual sync.

**Parameters:**

- `syncState` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `physicsSimulations` *(Map)* — editor.physicsSimulations
- `[spatialAuthoritySet]` *(Set)* — If provided, only broadcast sims for entities in this set (spatial zone filter)

**Returns:** |null}

### `applyRemotePbdState(op, physicsSimulations)`

Apply incoming PBD particle state from the authority (host). Non-authority clients do NOT run their own PBD solver for these sims — they just apply the received positions directly. Tags each sim with `_remoteAuthority = true` so stepPhysicsSimulations skips the local solver for it (prevents local physics from fighting the authoritative positions).

**Parameters:**

- `op` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `physicsSimulations` *(Map)* — editor.physicsSimulations

### `applyRemotePlayTransforms(op, peerId, ecsWorld, getEntityComponent, setEntityComponent, syncState)`

Apply incoming play_transforms from a remote peer. Pushes transforms into the interpolation buffer, measures jitter for adaptive delay, and detects "nuke" events (massive state changes) for instant snap.

### `interpolateRemoteEntities(syncState, ecsWorld, getEntityComponent, localDragEntityId, entityAuthority)`

Interpolate buffered remote transforms and write to ECS + physics. Called every render frame by non-authority peers. Uses adaptive render delay that auto-adjusts based on measured packet jitter. On LAN/good connections: as low as ~20ms. On jittery links: up to 150ms. Slowly tightens delay when stable; instantly widens on late arrivals.

### `getInterpDelay(syncState)`

Get the current adaptive interpolation delay (ms) for diagnostics.

### `getRemoteGrabGlows(syncState, presenceState)`

Get set of entity IDs currently being grabbed by remote peers. Returns Map<entityId, peerColor> for glow rendering.

**Parameters:**

- `syncState` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `presenceState` *(Object)* — CollabPresence state for peer colors

### `destroyTransformSync(syncState)`

Destroy / reset transform sync state.
